request.style: English, Chicago electric blues, gritty soulful male vocal, electric slide guitar, harmonica, Hammond organ, walking bass, shuffle drums, swaggering then hushed, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elijah stood before King Ahab, said no dew and no rain
Elijah stood before King Ahab, said no dew and no rain
Then the ravens brought him bread and meat, morning and evening again

[Verse]
Down in Zarephath a widow had one handful of flour
Down in Zarephath a widow had one handful of flour
But the jar did not run out and the oil kept pouring every hour

[Verse]
How long will you keep limping between two opinions, he said
Four hundred fifty prophets danced and shouted till the day was dead
He soaked the wood three times with water, filled the trench up to the brim
Then the fire of the LORD came down and licked it up for him

[Chorus]
The LORD, he is God
The LORD, he is God
Fire fell on Carmel and the people cried
The LORD, he is God

[Verse]
Then he ran from Jezebel and lay down underneath a broom bush
Said, Enough, LORD, take my life; I am no better than my fathers
But an angel touched him, get up and eat, a loaf on burning stones
Forty days and forty nights he walked to Horeb all alone

[Bridge]
Not in the wind
Not in the earthquake
Not in the fire
But the sound of a low whisper
What are you doing here, Elijah?

[Chorus]
The LORD, he is God
The LORD, he is God
Fire fell on Carmel and the people cried
The LORD, he is God

[Outro]
A chariot of fire and horses of fire
He went up to heaven in a whirlwind
My father! My father!
